spec.goal: Get a working calculator app that the user can use to perform calculations.
spec.deliverable: A calculator app that the user can open and use to enter numbers and perform calculations.
constraints: The request does not specify which operations to support, so stay general and cover basic arithmetic.
No platform, tech stack, design style or extra features were requested, so none should be added.
done_criteria: The app lets the user enter numbers and choose basic arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide).
The app displays the result of a calculation correctly.
The user can clear the current input or result to start a new calculation.
spec.summary: You want a calculator app that lets you enter numbers, perform basic calculations and see the results.
